question: Should imported non-security clusters containing only issues be allowed to close confirmed duplicates without first requiring a code-fix path?
rationale: Tests can verify the policy is implemented as written, but they cannot determine whether relaxing this autonomous safeguard matches the maintainers' intended cleanup posture.

options.title: Accept issue-only exception
options.body: Merge the bounded rule so issue-only duplicate clusters can close directly while pull-request-containing and security-sensitive clusters remain fix-first.

options.title: Keep universal fix-first gate
options.body: Retain the current behavior and require a fix path whenever fix or merge execution is enabled, even for issue-only duplicate clusters.

recommendation.title: Accept issue-only exception
recommendation.body: Merge the bounded rule so issue-only duplicate clusters can close directly while pull-request-containing and security-sensitive clusters remain fix-first.

likelyOwner.reason: As the member author defining this policy boundary, @vincentkoc is the clearest available owner to confirm the intended operational posture or route final approval.
